game.name: SoulCalibur V (World)
game.desc: SoulCalibur V is a fighting game for Xbox 360. A seventh episode of the famous "Soul" franchise under the sign of renewal. 17 years after the events of Soulcalibur IV, it is the turn of Patroklos, the son of Sophitia to join the quest for the Soul Edge. Alongside series veterans Nightmare, Ivy and Mitsurugi, the new blood of Pyrrha, Natsu and Z.W.E.I., to name but a few, will be added.
